# SDLC Mode (legacy alias)

SDLC Mode has been renamed **Poteto Mode** for user-facing workflows.
Read and follow `../poteto-mode/SKILL.md`, the canonical instructions, for
all new tasks. If the canonical Skill is missing or cannot be loaded, stop
and report the missing file rather than silently using old behavior.

This alias exists for backward compatibility only. No additional model,
tool, file-system, test, deployment or banking permissions are granted.
